text:
Aisha_CS: Quick heads-up — MeridianCare onboarding: their demo traffic is spiking and the EU edge is hitting RL. They asked for a short-lived config change for tomorrow's demo (4h window). Can ops own? :eyes:
Elaine_CSM: Thanks — renewal touchpoint next week; if demo goes well it's high impact. Need enablement link + any notes for the AE so they can call out improved latency.
Sam_Ops: I can take the change. Proposal: temporary rate window + IP allowlist and pin routing to eu-west-1 for demo traffic. Will we need a fallback to us-west-2?
Aisha_CS: Yes fallback to us-west-2 after 250ms p50 would be fine. Demo runners originate from 198.51.100.12 and 198.51.100.13. Also they use header X-MC-Demo=true to identify demo flows.
Devon_Engineer: Can we route by header? Our smart routing supports header-based policy but need rule added to customer config. ETA ~30m for rule change + QA.
Liam_SRE: Heads-up on infra: if we increase burst to 1.2k rps for that window we need to ensure KV cache warmup for their model to avoid token spikes. Recommend pre-warm using a small synthetic run 15m before demo.
Sam_Ops: Noted. I'll schedule a small pre-warm job. Also propose ephemeral allowlist rule with TTL 6h so it auto-revokes.
Aisha_CS: Perfect. Can you paste the exact config snippet you'll apply? Elaine, I'll share this with AE and MeridianCare ops.
Sam_Ops: Posting planned config below — I'll apply at 14:00 UTC tomorrow unless someone objects. :calendar:
```
customer: "meridiancare"
change: {
  allowlist_ips: ["198.51.100.12/32","198.51.100.13/32"],
  rate_limit: {region: "eu-west-1", burst_rps: "1200", window_start: "2024-09-23T14:00:00Z", window_end: "2024-09-23T18:00:00Z", autorevoke_ttl: "6h"},
  routing: {match_header: {name: "X-MC-Demo", value: "true"}, primary_region: "eu-west-1", fallback: "us-west-2", fallback_latency_ms: "250"}
}
```
Devon_Engineer: Config looks good. I'll add the header-match rule and validate on staging. Will post smoke results here.
Liam_SRE: I'll coordinate the cache warmup and watch token cost. If we see >15% regression in p95 during warmup we abort and rollback.
Elaine_CSM: I've briefed the AE and scheduled a quick 10m prep call 30m before start. Also logging a note in renewal tracker: "Demo scheduled w/ ephemeral rlift; success could materially reduce renewal risk."
deploy-bot: change_request meridiancare-1736543210 queued for manual approval by Sam_Ops at 2024-09-23T13:50:00Z
Sam_Ops: Approving now. Will run the pre-warm at 13:45 UTC and apply config at 14:00. I’ll update this thread with smoke results and the revoke time when done.
Aisha_CS: Awesome — thanks team. Please @channel any major regressions. I'll capture feedback from MeridianCare PM post-demo and drop notes here.
